description: Expected live-turn classifier routes for Campaign 2 Session 22. GM lines are reconstructed Live Control utterances derived from the user's actual Session 22 staging/planning language: terse roll commands, recap-style table notes, natural GM prompts, corrections, and post-session asks.
corpus_rationale: Each fixture cites the staging section where the roll, decision, beat, or prep request was logged. Realign gold when staging canon changes (verify-before-debug); do not deflate expectations to match a single LLM run. Runtime/manual smoke data belongs in temp or artifact directories, not committed live session JSONL seeds.
fixture_style_notes: Include terse at-table commands: Weather 7, R5 54, T-NPC 7.
Include the user's recap/update phrasing: 'Record...', 'Correction:', 'They push through...', 'keep ... owed'.
Distinguish logging a played fact from asking for context/prep.
Allow routing_alternates only where the source itself is ambiguous between state_note and canon_commit.
